# Overdue ladder

Code picks the step and tone from days overdue (get_invoices returns both).

| Days overdue | Step | Tone |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | heads_up |
| 1 | 1 | soft |
| 2 | 1 | soft |
| 3 | 3 | soft |
| 6 | 3 | soft |
| 7 | 7 | firm |
| 13 | 7 | firm |
| 14 | 14 | firm |
| 30 | 14 | firm |

Step 7 tells the rep; step 14 is the owner's decision. One reminder a day at most, and a firm reminder or one over the owner's limit waits for approval (Go policy).
